ambiguity: The text names the contents (family correspondence/photographs) and says the box proceeds to destruction. It never says the loss is irreplaceable or irreversible, so I coded 'mentioned'. The grounds for the decision are the registered status and policy that pending requests do not change dates. 'No discretionary extensions... per your instruction' is a general statement, not tied to this box, so I left 'instruction' out; it could arguably be added. The remedy is 'Please confirm at the sitting if you want it held' plus an offer to re-check. The sitting is tomorrow, after the 14:30 destruction, so this reads as a flag for later review rather than a request to stop the destruction. Whether the re-check offer counts as an override request is borderline.
